newsitem.title: ITALY: Pirelli first 4 month 1997 results in line.
newsitem.headline: Pirelli first 4 month 1997 results in line.

text.p: Results from Italian tyre and cables group Pirelli in the first four months of 1997 were in line with the same period in 1996, chairman Marco Tronchetti Provera told an annual shareholder meeting on Monday.
Sales were in line in the tyre sector, while there was a slight fall in the cables side which will be recovered in the second half of the year, Tronchetti said.

"For cables we hope for a positive year, the decline in demand in Italy and France will be compensated by the rise in activity in North and Latin America and from important contracts already signed," he said.
"Fibre optics continues to rise, we operate in a competitive world but we have technology already and hope for important results in this activity, he added.

In submarine cables, there is a slowdown. In 1996 there was an important contract in Malaysia and in 1997 there are important contacts which will bear fruit in the second half of the year. In the tyre sector, he saw a positive year.
